interestingFact: India is home to the world's largest democracy and the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
Japan has more than 6,800 islands and is famous for its advanced technology and bullet trains.
Brazil contains about 60% of the Amazon Rainforest, the largest tropical rainforest on Earth.
Australia is the only country that is also an entire continent and is home to unique wildlife like kangaroos and koalas.
Canada has the longest coastline in the world, stretching over 202,000 kilometers.
The Eiffel Tower in Paris was once the tallest man-made structure in the world.
Egypt's Great Pyramid of Giza is the oldest and only surviving wonder of the Ancient World.
The Great Wall of China stretches over 21,000 kilometers and is one of the world's most famous landmarks.
Italy is home to the Colosseum, one of the greatest architectural achievements of the Roman Empire.
South Africa has three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein.
